# Colts' struggling offense does just enough to beat Dolphins 24-22 and snap 5-game skid

* * *

By AP

Updated: Nov 15, 2026, 06:02 pm

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

After losing five straight and enduring three weeks of tumult, they finally celebrated a victory.

[Daniel Jones](http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3917792/daniel-jones) threw for one score, [Seth McGowan](http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4686468/seth-mcgowan) ran for another and [Adetomiwa Adebawore](http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4427635/adetomiwa-adebawore) recovered a fumble for a touchdown on Sunday as the Colts held on for a 24-22 victory over the [Miami Dolphins](http://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/mia/miami-dolphins) to end their skid.

recap.paragraph: Miami came close, but the Colts won 24-22 in Indianapolis. Seth McGowan ran 4 yards for a Colts touchdown. Miami struck back when Malik Washington hit Jalen Tolbert for a 34-yard touchdown. Adetomiwa Adebawore recovered a fumble in the end zone for a Colts touchdown. Then Miami grabbed momentum as Chris Johnson returned an interception 59 yards for a touchdown! Kyle McCord ran for a score, but the 2-point try failed. The Colts ended a 5-game skid and improved to 3-7, while Miami fell to 1-8.
